text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, another message of support arrived. 
It's been ringing non-stop since this 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My family, my acquaintances, and everyone 
who has supported me... Whenever I wish to 
spur myself on, they are all by my side.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To live up to everyone's feelings— I will 
definitely win this race!
